data.name: Ambrish
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘ambhu’ meaning water and ‘rish’ meaning master or sage. This name signifies one who is immortal or imperishable, a wise and enlightened soul. In Hindu mythology, Ambrish is the name of a sage who had the power to control the elements of water and fire.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the divine qualities of wisdom, enlightenment, and mastery over the elements.
